records.limitations: Reviewed low-alloyed cast-stock market helper. Preserve every inspected source producer share, its BOF/electric route and original separate road, rail, barge and sea delivery demand. Use the complete native RER low-alloyed converter/casting process for BOF supply and the complete native Swiss low-alloyed electric/casting process for electric supply as independently inspected same whole-material/function/unit geographic proxies. All 25 source producer references and all six native component references are positive 1; source markets have a self-linked positive 1 kg reference and only active technosphere inputs. Their declared endpoints are steelmaking and casting; the Austrian narrative mentions downstream rolling but its included-activities boundary ends at billets. No source or chosen native producer has a direct rolling-service input. Do not import the old native whole-market target: it adds one kg hot rolling and fixes the furnace split at 63% BOF/37% electric. This helper retains source route shares without extra rolling, an alloy/iron ratio, scrap yield, 0.99 allocation multiplier, capacity normalization, new steelmaking primitive or recovered-product credit. Preserve complete native alloy additions, infrastructure, scrap sourcing, by-product gases, wastes and allocation once. The native Swiss electric process has 0.99 economic allocation to steel; other source plants, technologies, alloy recipes, steel quality and coproduct allocation are approximated, not reconstructed. Whole native freight services retain vehicle/rail/ship/port/infrastructure/fuel/emissions inventories at the original signed net-ton-km quantities; native fleet, rail/ship class, geography, trade representation and vintage differ. No individual traction, payload, gross-weight or distance multiplier is inferred. Specific mechanical grades or application performance, inventory and LCIA equivalence are unverified; effects on scores are unquantified. Preserve signed caller quantities, uncertainty, formulas, ownership and separate processing/emissions. Only the enumerated exact cut-off profiles qualify; no inverse or cross-system-model route is inferred. Repeated native furnace suppliers are combined only for deterministic source shares, without rounding or renormalizing them; each freight exchange retains its original uncertainty.

deterministic_aggregation: Only deterministic repeated native casting suppliers are summed. Original detailed source coefficients are retained privately as inventory fingerprints and inspected witnesses; target recipes expose only derived furnace totals and the required delivery coordinates. Source route totals and each freight uncertainty remain unchanged.
